entities.summary: Gilles Vidal is a French car designer, appointed Director of Style by Peugeot in early-2010. He was responsible for the design direction of the 2010s decade at Peugeot. He was the design director at Renault between 2020 and October 2025, but then rejoined Stellantis as the design director for Stellantis European brands.
